title: Raiton Kage Bunshin
body:
Syntax: perform raiton kage bunshin

Description: Summons one Lightning clone that fights with you and can paralyze. Summons one living clone that fights alongside you and costs an average 3.75 Chakra per round. Requires 100% Shadow Clone Jutsu mastery; recasting any clone replaces the existing clones. Requires Lightning chakra nature. Unlocks at level 45. Costs 55 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 10 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
